title.narrative: Strengthening Governance, Integrity, and Legacy in Sport in Eastern Africa

description.narrative: This workplan is guided by UNESCO’s global normative frameworks, and aligns with the Fit for Life initiative for positioning sport as a driver for sustainable development through multi-stakeholder partnerships, and contributing to SDGs 3, 4, 5, and 16. Building on previous efforts, the plan will strengthen stakeholder engagement through key advocacy platforms such as the International Day of Sport for Development and Peace and the International Day of University Sport, while promoting inclusion and safeguarding in and through sport. Beyond supporting the translation of the UNESCO Sport Charter into Kiswahili, and supporting sport policy development in Madagascar and South Sudan, this workplan will leverage on AFCON 2027, co-hosted by Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania, as strategic opportunity to advance inclusive sport policies, strengthen integrity and anti-doping efforts, and build a lasting development legacy in collaboration with key regional and international partners.
